observations.start: Servius, Teokan of Ralos, in the Sunrise Palace near 1681,3168,0 after The Heart of Darkness and Perilous Moons.
observations.requirements: 66 Thieving, 52 Fletching and 52 Runecraft, nonboostable in the pinned helper. Requires the completion of The Heart of Darkness and Perilous Moons.
observations.route: Investigate the Twilight temple backroom/canvas and fight an Enforcer; inform the queen and Captain Vibia; recover the hideout's purse and key; interview Attala and Servius in Cam Torum; solve the pub's ordered drink arrangement; travel through Neypotzli streambound, earthbound and prison caverns; defeat cultists; meet Servius at Tal Teklan; navigate Tonali Cavern with Ennius, coloured teleporters and lift; solve six sun-rune placements using urn essence, then moon roots and loose blade; defeat Metzli and inspect the final area's pillars, door and skeleton before claiming the reward.
observations.alternative_paths: The pinned helper lists alternative approaches via Pendant of Ates, Salvager Overlook and the gorge; alternate floor moves in the hideout, alternate entrances to Earthbound/Ancient Prison, a north-area Agility shortcut and duplicate final-boss status UI. These are deliberately not modelled as mandatory consecutive quest stages, and their travel-option details require review.
observations.resources: One bone for the guard dog, an existing Emissary robe outfit from Heart, a knife for the potted fan, ordered Cam Torum drinks and their empty glass, canvas fragments, a corpse key, six puzzle-essence crafts, moon roots and the loose blade. Reusable item retention, alternative food/meat for the dog, free knife supply and exact item counts still need gameplay confirmation.
observations.combat: Emissary Enforcer, Neypotzli and Tonali cultists, Ennius, and Metzli. All success checks are conditional; no fake guaranteed food, prayer potion or death-recovery cost is applied.
observations.completion: 3 quest points, 55,000 Thieving XP, 25,000 Fletching XP, 25,000 Runecraft XP, Arkan blade, plus one retainable 55,000-XP combat lamp for a combat skill including Prayer at level 40+.

review_gaps: The pinned helper has 121 waypoint candidates, including alternate routes and UI-status duplicates. Independently check skipped alternate entryways and whether additional parallel travel edges are needed for a globally optimal route.
Verify the temple's canvas piece count and where pieces are found; this draft collects two from drawers and consumes two at the picture, but all source selectors must be checked in-game.
Confirm which bones/meats are accepted by the guard dog, whether the knife is freely available within the hideout and exact door passcode/lockpick retry conditions.
Verify Cam Torum drink/item names, the Galna beer interaction, ordered barrel/glass puzzle, used vessels and how consumed supplies can be reclaimed on a failed arrangement.

The Neypotzli caverns and Tonali's teleporter/rope/lift routes use candidate tiles; distinguish true walk edges from one-way instance transitions, floor paths and stage-dependent shortcuts during in-game replay.

The sun puzzle's six rune-crafting placements and moon roots/knife blade steps are modeled as conditional outcomes; check exact source essence quantities, rule ordering, reusable tool handling and alternate solver paths.
The final Metzli encounter, retry/deathbank mechanism, post-boss area and final reward pickup need independent confirmation. Do not assume fixed combat food, equipment damage or incidental XP.

The held lamp permits combat skills including Prayer at level 40+; verify min-level wording and reclaim behavior against Jagex notes and the live game. The Arkan blade is a fixed reward but its equip restrictions are not modeled here.
All travel times, fight durations, world/instance tiles and item identities are estimates. This batch is collected draft data, not independently reviewed.
